clues: This city was founded in 1872 on the east bank of a great river, in the middle of the northern plains. It began as a railroad town.
Winters here are cold, dry, snowy, and windy. Summers are warm, with storms in the spring and summer months.
In 1883, this rail town was made the capital of a vast new land. Six years on, it kept the job when that land became a state.
The capitol here is a tall tower of 19 floors, the tallest in the state. Folks call it the skyscraper of the flat plains.
North Dakota's governor works in this town. Its lawmakers meet in the tall capitol on the plains.
